title: AI Automation for Small Business: Owner Checklist Before Buying a Tool
summary: A no-credentials, synthetic checklist covering trigger, owner, rules, exceptions and the smallest evidence-matched next move.
answer: A small business should define the repeatable job, accountable owner, rule-versus-judgement steps, exception stop path and reversible evidence-matched next move before selecting AI automation.
claim_boundary: Not a client case study, productivity guarantee, savings claim, security assessment, legal/compliance advice, ranking, demand or customer outcome.
